description: Get the report for an uploaded PDF: page count, page size, the size its pages are or are scaled to (by_sku[sku].page_fit, e.g. A4 at 10×), and warnings. The report is advice: no file is refused for its content, and our print team checks every file against the order after payment. The one exception is a storybook, whose page count sets the price: create_order refuses a count we do not price (page_count_out_of_range). Free to call. Reads only your own uploads: without an API key, the uploads you made without one; with a key, that key's uploads.
name: validate_pdf
title: PDF upload report
